cohort: Newborns born within 96 hours at Al-Bashir Hospital in Amman, Jordan, were enrolled from February 2010 to June 2011.
finding: Lower gestational age, lower birth weight, delivery by caesarean section, and birth in May were statistically significant risk factors for NICU admission.
mod_finding: Delivery by caesarean section was a statistically significant risk factor for NICU admission.
